Tells what [RawInput](RawInput) was last set to.
@returns 1 if raw input was asked for, otherwise 0 (the initial value). It says what was asked for, not whether the platform can do it; that is [HWRawInput](HWRawInput).
@gap This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
